voted_differently_from_majority.title: Amendment of Municipal Code Titles 1, 3, 4, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 14A, 14B, 14X and 15 (2026 Municipal Code Revenue Ordinance Alternative)
Fiscal Year 2026 Tax Levy, as amended

Amendment of Municipal Code Titles 2, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 14A, 15, 17 regarding management, structure, powers and functions of various departments and agencies (2026 Municipal Code Management Ordinance)
Corrections and revisions to 2026 Budget Recommendations and text portion of Annual Appropriation Ordinance
Amendment of Municipal Code Chapter 6-105 modifying timelines for employer allowance minimums in hourly wage occupations receiving gratuities

Amendment of Municipal Code Chapter 2-8 by adding new Section 2-8-036 regarding ordinance requirements for issuance of bonds and other indebtedness including approval by three-fifths affirmative vote of alderpersons for ordinances authorizing debt issuance

Amendment of Municipal Code by adding Section 2-32-385 regarding Ongoing Metered Parking Concession Payments and allocation of Concession Payments among City pension funds (pursuant to Section 2.3 of SO2026-0025407)
